name: Parametric EQ (8-band)
purpose: Eight-band parametric EQ for high-pass and low-pass filtering, corrective cuts (mud, boxiness, harshness) and broad tonal shaping.

latency.note: IIR mode has zero latency; FIR, FFT and SPM modes add latency (linear phase).

params.name: Equalizer mode
params.ai_hint: IIR for tracking and nearly all mixing. FIR (linear phase) only on a master or bus where phase shift matters.

params.name: Output gain
params.ai_hint: Compensate for large boosts or cuts so the module's output level matches its input.

params.name: Filter type 0
params.ai_hint: Leave unused bands Off. Use Hi-pass on band 0 to remove rumble below the source's lowest useful note.

params.name: Frequency 0
params.ai_hint: Centre or corner frequency in Hz.

params.name: Gain 0
params.ai_hint: Prefer cuts to boosts. Corrective cuts are usually 2-6 dB; boosts rarely above 4 dB.

params.name: Quality factor 0
params.ai_hint: Bell width. 0.7 broad and musical, 2-4 for targeted cuts, 8+ for notching resonances.

params.name: Filter slope 0
params.ai_hint: Steepness for pass and shelf filters: x1 gentle (12 dB/oct) to x4 steep.

hidden_params.reason: Per-band filter mode, width, solo/mute, input gain and analyser controls stay at defaults; they are display or expert controls.

notes: LSP stores gains as linear amplitude; Plugsalot converts from dB (convert = db_to_amp).
Upstream Q default is 0. Confirm how LSP treats Q = 0 for each filter mode before relying on the upstream default; Plugsalot always sends an explicit Q.
